3. Who We Are

Hureeyerhs Limited is a diversified Nigerian company operating across interior design and custom furniture, travel and tourism, fragrances and lifestyle products, and beauty and personal care services. Through our specialised business divisions, we provide innovative solutions, quality products, and professional services tailored to the needs of individuals, businesses, and organisations.

We are driven by creativity, excellence, integrity, and a commitment to customer satisfaction. Our goal is to build a trusted and sustainable business that delivers exceptional value, creates employment opportunities, and contributes to economic growth while expanding our reach across Nigeria and international markets.

4. Our Mission

Our mission is to provide innovative, high-quality, and customer-focused solutions across our business divisions, including interior design, furniture production, travel services, fragrances, and beauty care. We are committed to exceeding customer expectations through professionalism, creativity, integrity, and continuous improvement while creating opportunities for employment, skills development, and sustainable business growth.

5. Our Vision

Our vision is to establish Hureeyerhs Limited as a leading and trusted Nigerian business group with a strong presence across interior design, furniture, travel and tourism, fragrances, and beauty services. We aspire to expand into new markets, build strategic partnerships, empower individuals through skills development, and become recognised for excellence, innovation, quality, and outstanding customer experiences.

6. Our Core Values

Excellence and Quality

We strive to maintain high standards in our products, services, and customer relationships.

Integrity and Transparency

We conduct our business honestly, honour our commitments, and build relationships based on trust and accountability.

Creativity and Innovation

We embrace fresh ideas, modern solutions, and continuous improvement to remain relevant and competitive.

Customer Satisfaction

Our customers are at the heart of our business. We listen, understand their needs, and work to provide solutions that deliver genuine value.

Growth and Empowerment

We believe in developing people, creating employment opportunities, supporting entrepreneurship, and building a sustainable business that contributes positively to society.

7. Why We Started the Business

Hureeyerhs Limited grew out of a passion for entrepreneurship, creativity, and the desire to create meaningful solutions that improve people’s lives. Our journey began with the determination to turn ideas into practical services and build a business that could serve different needs while creating opportunities for growth and development.

As the business evolved, our interests and expertise expanded into different sectors, including beauty, fragrances, interior design, custom furniture, and travel services. Each division reflects our commitment to identifying opportunities, delivering quality, and creating value for our customers.

Today, Hureeyerhs Limited represents a vision that goes beyond running individual businesses. We are building a structured, diversified, and sustainable company that brings together different services under one corporate identity. Our long-term goal is to expand our operations, establish strategic partnerships, create employment opportunities, empower young people through skills development, and build a respected Nigerian company with an international outlook.

CRAFT BY HUREEYERH

Furniture, Interior & Exterior Design, Decoration, Construction & Finishing

Established 2020

1. What Do You Offer?

Craft by Hureeyerh is a furniture, interior and exterior design, decoration, space finishing, and construction brand providing creative and practical solutions for residential, commercial, hospitality, office, and event spaces.

We design, build, furnish, decorate, and transform spaces according to each client’s needs, preferences, budget, and intended use.

  • Interior design and space planning.
  • Exterior design and building façade development.
  • Full building construction.
  • Renovation, remodelling, and property improvement.
  • Custom furniture design and production.
  • Wardrobes, kitchen cabinets, shelves, TV consoles, beds, tables, chairs, sofas, and fitted furniture.
  • Office, home, hotel, restaurant, and commercial furniture.
  • POP ceiling design and installation.
  • Wall screeding and surface preparation.
  • Interior and exterior painting.
  • Wall panelling and decorative wall treatments.
  • Floor and wall tiling.
  • Plumbing, electrical, and other building finishing works.
  • Doors, windows, partitions, fittings, lighting design and installation.
  • Interior decoration and styling, exterior decoration, landscaping, and outdoor space improvement.
  • Event, office, residential, and commercial space decoration.
  • Project supervision and coordination.
  • Space makeovers, complete finishing packages, and custom design solutions.

Our goal is to create beautiful, functional, durable, and well-finished spaces that reflect each client’s personality, lifestyle, brand, and purpose.

2. Year Started

Year established: 2020

3. Best-Selling Services

  • Custom furniture design and production.
  • Interior and exterior design.
  • POP ceiling installation.

  • Kitchen cabinets and fitted wardrobes.

4. Price Range

Price range: ₦10,000 to ₦1,000,000,000

Prices vary according to project type and size, materials, design complexity, labour, location, finishing standards, quantities, and project duration. Clients may request individual services or complete design, construction, furnishing, and finishing packages.

5. Custom Orders and Projects

Yes, we accept customised orders and projects. Craft by Hureeyerh accepts customised furniture orders, interior and exterior design projects, construction, renovation, decoration, and space-finishing contracts.

Clients may customise designs and layouts, colours and finishes, furniture dimensions, materials and textures, POP patterns, paint colours, wall treatments, tiles, cabinets, wardrobes, storage, lighting, decorative themes, building plans, and finishing specifications for residential, office, commercial, hospitality, and event spaces.

Projects may require site inspection, measurements, design consultation, quotations, material selection, approval of drawings or concepts, a deposit, and an agreed schedule before work begins.

6. What Makes Craft by Hureeyerh Different?

We combine design creativity, construction knowledge, practical planning, quality workmanship, and attention to detail to deliver spaces that are attractive, comfortable, functional, and durable.

Complete Space Solutions: Design, construction, furniture, decoration, and finishing through one brand.

Custom Furniture and Fittings: Made to suit each client’s space, measurements, lifestyle, storage needs, and style.

Creative Design: Interior and exterior designs balancing beauty, comfort, functionality, and durability.

Professional Finishing: POP, painting, screeding, tiling, wall treatments, ceilings, fittings, and other finishing works.

Construction and Project Coordination: Support from planning through structural work and interior/exterior completion.

Attention to Detail: Accurate measurements, suitable materials, neat installation, and careful coordination.

Different Spaces and Budgets: Homes, offices, shops, hotels, restaurants, event centres, religious facilities, schools, and other properties; from individual services to large projects.

Our ambition is to establish Craft by Hureeyerh as a trusted design, construction, furniture, decoration, and space-finishing brand known for creativity, quality workmanship, reliable service, and well-executed projects.

HUREEYERHS TRAVELS AND LOGISTICS PRIDE LIMITED

Travel Management, Tourism, Pilgrimage and Logistics Support

1. Services Offered

Hureeyerhs Travels and Logistics Pride Limited helps individuals, families, businesses, and groups plan and manage travel arrangements with convenience, professionalism, and care. Services are tailored for leisure, business, religious pilgrimage, family holidays, and international travel.

  • Flight Ticket Reservations: Domestic and international flight reservations, ticketing through appropriate booking channels, itinerary assistance, and flight information support.
  • Visa Assistance: Guidance on application requirements, document preparation, appointments, and procedures. Visa approval remains the responsibility of the relevant authority.
  • Hotel Reservations: Accommodation options suited to clients’ budgets, destinations, and preferences.
  • Tour Packages: Holiday planning for individuals, couples, families, groups, and corporate travellers.
  • Pilgrimage Travel: Umrah coordination, including flights, accommodation in Makkah and Madinah, ground transportation, and agreed support services.
  • Corporate Travel Management: Travel arrangements for businesses, conferences, meetings, and professional assignments.
  • Group and Family Travel: Coordinated travel arrangements for families, friends, organisations, and groups.
  • Travel Consultation: Destination selection, itinerary planning, accommodation options, travel documentation, and trip preparation.
  • Logistics and Travel Support: Agreed travel-related logistics and coordination services.

Our objective is to provide reliable travel support that helps clients plan their journeys confidently, comfortably, and efficiently.

2. Year Established

2025

Saudi Arabia

  • Umrah pilgrimage packages.
  • Makkah and Madinah accommodation.

  • Group and family pilgrimage arrangements.

  • Dubai holiday packages.

  • Leisure, shopping, and sightseeing trips.

  • Holiday and sightseeing packages.

Other International Destinations and Nigeria

We assist with international and domestic travel planning, flight reservations, hotel bookings, business travel, family holidays, and group trips, subject to availability and applicable entry requirements.

4. Sample Prices and Packages

Packages are tailored to destination, travel dates, airline, accommodation category, duration, group size, and services requested. Options include Umrah packages, holiday packages, flight reservations, hotel booking packages, and corporate travel services.

Pricing: Current prices are available on request and confirmed according to travel dates, availability, exchange rates, supplier rates, and the services included. Formal quotations can be prepared for individuals, families, groups, organisations, and corporate clients.

5. Certifications and Professional Affiliations

Business and industry status: CAC, NANTA, NCAA and IATA are listed as in view. Memberships, registrations, and accreditations should be represented as confirmed only after they have been obtained.

Relevant affiliations may include the National Association of Nigerian Travel Agencies (NANTA), International Air Transport Association (IATA) accreditation where applicable, relevant tourism registrations, and partnerships with reputable travel providers.

6. What Makes Us Different?

  • Personalised Travel Planning: Arrangements based on clients’ destinations, budgets, preferences, and objectives.
  • Pilgrimage Support: Organised Umrah arrangements to help pilgrims focus on their spiritual journey.
  • Multiple Services in One Place: Assistance with flights, accommodation, visa application guidance, tours, and related travel arrangements.
  • Customer-Focused Service: Clear communication, timely updates, and responsive assistance.
  • Flexible Solutions: Options for individuals, families, groups, business travellers, and organisations.
  • Professional Coordination: Careful booking coordination and communication of applicable requirements.
  • Transparency: Clear information about inclusions, exclusions, payment terms, cancellations, and other travel conditions.
  • Growing Partnership Network: Building relationships with reputable airlines, hotels, tour operators, and travel partners.

Our long-term goal is to become a trusted travel and tourism brand recognised for dependable service, organised pilgrimage experiences, customer satisfaction, and professionally managed travel arrangements.

SCENTS BY HUREEYERH

Luxury Fragrances, Incense & Lifestyle Scent Products

1. What Do You Sell?

Scents by Hureeyerh is a fragrance and lifestyle brand specialising in quality perfumes, luxury bakhoor, traditional incense, perfume oils, and home fragrance products. We offer a diverse collection of scents designed to enhance personal grooming, create inviting environments, and bring elegance and a memorable fragrance experience to everyday life.

Our product range includes:

  • Luxury Bakhoor and Incense: Premium bakhoor, traditional incense, and specially selected fragrance blends for homes, special occasions, and cultural gatherings.
  • Perfumes: Personal fragrances for men and women, suitable for everyday use and special occasions.
  • Perfume Oils: Concentrated fragrance oils for customers who appreciate distinctive and rich scents.
  • Khumrah: Fragrant blends designed to complement personal fragrance routines and traditional beauty practices.
  • Home Fragrances: Room sprays, air fresheners, reed diffusers, and other products that create pleasant indoor environments.
  • Scented Candles: Fragrant candles for homes, relaxation, and decorative purposes.
  • Car Fragrances: Products designed to keep vehicles smelling fresh and pleasant.
  • Fragrance Accessories: Scent burners and other accessories used to enjoy and display fragrance products.
  • Wholesale and Retail Supply: Fragrance products available to individual customers, retailers, resellers, and bulk buyers.

Our goal is to make quality fragrances accessible to a wide range of customers while offering products that suit different preferences, lifestyles, and budgets.

2. Year Started

Year established: 2020

3. Best-Selling Products

Our key product categories include:

  • Luxury bakhoor and traditional incense.
  • Premium perfume oils.
  • Long-lasting personal perfumes.
  • Exclusive khumrah collections.
  • Traditional incense blends, including Kajiji.
  • Home and room fragrances.
  • Fragrance burners and accessories.

We continually explore new fragrance varieties and product combinations to meet changing customer preferences and introduce distinctive scent experiences to the market.

4. Price Range

Retail price range: ₦2,000 to ₦1,000,000.

Wholesale price range: ₦250,000 to ₦50,000,000.

Our pricing varies according to product category, size, fragrance composition, packaging, and quantity purchased. We offer retail and wholesale purchasing options to serve individual customers, resellers, and businesses.

5. Who Buys from Us?

Scents by Hureeyerh serves a diverse customer base, including:

  • Individuals who appreciate quality perfumes and personal fragrances.
  • Men and women seeking distinctive everyday and luxury scents.
  • Customers who enjoy traditional incense and bakhoor.
  • Brides, grooms, and families preparing for weddings and special occasions.
  • Households seeking pleasant and welcoming home fragrances.
  • Hotels, offices, event centres, and hospitality businesses.
  • Retailers, wholesalers, and fragrance resellers.
  • Gift buyers looking for elegant fragrance products.
  • Customers interested in traditional beauty and fragrance practices.

We also serve customers seeking bulk purchases and business opportunities in the fragrance market.

6. What Makes Our Scents Different?

At Scents by Hureeyerh, we believe that fragrance is more than a product; it is an experience that creates an atmosphere, expresses personality, and leaves a lasting impression.

What distinguishes our brand is our combination of traditional fragrance culture, modern scent preferences, product variety, and a strong commitment to customer satisfaction.

Our competitive strengths include:

  • A Diverse Fragrance Collection: We offer a variety of scents, from soft and refreshing fragrances to rich, deep, traditional, and luxurious blends.
  • A Blend of Tradition and Modernity: Our collection celebrates traditional incense and fragrance practices while embracing contemporary perfume and home fragrance products.
  • Options for Different Budgets: We aim to provide products at different price points, making fragrance shopping accessible to a broad customer base.
  • Retail and Wholesale Opportunities: We serve both individual customers and bulk buyers, creating opportunities for retailers and resellers to grow their businesses.
  • Attention to Presentation: We recognise the importance of attractive packaging and product presentation, particularly for luxury purchases and gifts.
  • Customer-Focused Service: We help customers explore fragrance options that suit their preferences, intended use, and budget.
  • A Growing Luxury Brand: We are committed to strengthening our market presence through product innovation, strategic partnerships, customer education, and consistent brand development.

Our long-term ambition is to establish Scents by Hureeyerh as a recognised fragrance brand known for quality, distinctive scent experiences, and dependable customer service.
